data.text:
#WALANGPASOK | Base sa anunsyo ng Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG), suspendido ang pasok sa lahat ng antas ng paaralan at tanggapan ng gobyerno sa buong Metro Manila ngayong Lunes, September 1, 2025, dahil sa inaasahang masamang panahon.

Patuloy namang kikilos at maghahatid ng serbisyong medikal, law enforcement, traffic management, disaster at emergency response at iba pang essential services ang mga ahensiya ng QC Government.

Ipinauubaya rin sa pamunuan ng mga pribadong kumpanya at opisina ang desisyon kung sususpendihin ang kanilang mga operasyon.

Mag-ingat po tayong lahat, QCitizens!

#StaySafeQC

Quezon City Flooding Event

Flooding Event in Quezon City (August 30, 2025)

● A severe thunderstorm affected the northern portions of Metro Manila on August 30, 2025, between 1:00 PM and 4:00 PM.
● The Science Garden Station recorded 134.2 mm of rainfall, which is nearly equivalent to one week’s worth of rain based on the monthly normal of 568.5 mm.
● This heavy downpour caused significant flooding in several areas of Quezon City.
